failed_or_abandoned: First run: numpy 2.x refuses float() on 1-element arrays returned by er_means -> scalar helper added.

First engine layout (5x5 quadrature nodes, 1-keV energy grid, log10 S2c grid stopping at 4.40) omitted the ER band itself and was too slow (> 10 min for the k calibration alone); replaced by 3x3 nodes, 2-keV grid, grid to 5.20, special.ndtr, and a 5-point k-grid with interpolation.

Fig. 5 y-calibration from ticks on the LEFT frame edge failed for the top/middle panels (histogram lines start on that edge) and the assumed decades-per-tick were wrong for the middle panel; switched to right-edge ticks with a spacing rule (verified: bottom total 0.0108 vs 0.0106, middle 24.6 events vs ~25 data points).
212Pb statistics from single-marker blobs only were biased towards outliers; replaced by multiplicity-weighted blobs (still approximate).
Second run crashed in Figure 3 on a literal '%' in a format string after all numerical results had been logged (run_log_first_pass.txt); fixed and rerun.
Black-point counting in Fig. 5 (data_points) is unreliable in the top panel (merged markers) and was not used.
